name: agent_guard
description: A physical approve button for AI agents. When an agent wants to push, deploy, delete or pay, the request appears on the console: hold A+B to approve or press X to deny. The answer is signed by a key that never leaves the SE050 secure element, so the system that runs the action can check a human said yes. Works with Claude Code hooks, MCP clients and any HTTP client over Wi-Fi; host tools in AkiraSDK/tools/agent_guard.
